name: Dauthi
description: Dominarians trapped in the Shadows and driven insane.

description_citations.text: "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrier disturbances pull Dominarian creatures into Rath, and the Thalakos, Dauthi and Soltari become trapped in the Shadows.
timeline.quote: They were all trapped within the " Shadows ," the extraplanar space between Rath and Dominaria.

citation.text: "Rath", section "The Dauthi, Thalakos, and Soltari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Trapped in the Shadows, some Dauthi lose their sanity and manifest as horrors.
timeline.quote: This predicament led the Dauthi to lose their sanity, and some of them manifested as horrors ( Dauthi Horror ).

citation.text: "Horror", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Shadow people who are enemies of the Soltari.
